reviews.text: I love the whole collection of this mask . I haven’t tried the vit C and cica one as I don’t need them . But I will keep buying these masks. They works well under makeup. Not too greasy or sticky . Just the right amount . And it takes 5 mins only . I’m 40 yo and it is still sufficient for me which is great
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個面膜系列嘅所有款式。我未試過 vit C 同 cica 嗰款，因為我唔需要。不過我會繼續買呢啲面膜。佢哋化妝之下用都好好。唔會太油或者太黏。份量啱啱好。而且只需要五分鐘。我今年四十歲，對我嚟講仲係夠用，咁就好好。

reviews.text: Absorbs very quickly, didn’t notice anything special. Just regular masks
reviews.zh: 吸收好快，冇覺得有咩特別，就係普通面膜咁。

reviews.text: Really good face mask. It leaves my face feeling refresh and I noticed my skin get brighter. I will definitely be repurchasing it.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅面膜。用完面部感覺清新，我留意到皮膚更亮。我一定會再買。

reviews.text: Love the mask for what it did for my skin. But, only issue is that the smell of the starchy rice can be off putting for some people, which I don’t mind it.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個面膜對皮膚嘅效果。不過，唯一問題係，米嘅澱粉味可能令一啲人覺得唔舒服，但我就唔介意。

reviews.text:
One of the best products i used so far great for acne prone sensitive skin. You can literaly see the difference even after a single use.
Definitely repurchase
reviews.zh:
係我至今用過最好嘅產品之一，好適合易生暗瘡嘅敏感肌。用一次都真係睇到分別。
一定會再買。

reviews.text: Perfect mask for mornings where you’re in a rush! The rice mask is great for sensitive skin that needs brightening and the carrot mask just smells wonderful!
reviews.zh: 啱晒趕時間嘅早晨使用嘅完美面膜！米面膜好適合需要提亮嘅敏感皮膚，而紅蘿蔔面膜嘅味道真係好好聞！

reviews.text:
The SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Daily Mask is a soothing and refreshing treat for dull skin. Each sheet is soaked in lightweight essence that hydrates instantly without feeling sticky. After using it, my skin looks more even, feels smoother, and has that soft, healthy glow that rice-based skincare is known for. 

It’s gentle enough for daily use but gives noticeable brightness after just a few applications. The scent is light and clean, and the masks come in a convenient container that keeps them moist and easy to pull out.
reviews.zh:
SKINFOOD Rice Brightening Daily Mask 係一款令暗啞皮膚感到舒緩同清新嘅護理。每片面膜都浸滿輕盈精華，即時保濕，又唔會黏手。用完之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更均勻、摸落更滑，亦有米系護膚一向好出名嗰種柔和健康嘅光澤。

溫和到可以日常使用，而且只係用幾次已經有明顯嘅提亮效果。香味清淡乾淨，面膜裝喺方便嘅盒裝容器入面，可以保持濕潤，亦容易抽取。

reviews.text: I really love this mask .It really doesnt irritate your skin if you have acne prone skin.Really moisturizing and you can see brightening even after single use. Will definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個面膜。如果你易生暗瘡，佢真係唔會刺激皮膚。保濕效果好好，淨係用一次已經見到提亮效果。一定會再買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
